tasks.prompt: Create a production animation sprite sheet for ONLY the first, armored warrior from reference, preserving identity, equipment, palette and rear view. The other five characters must not appear. EXACT 3 columns x 3 rows of equal cells, 9 frames, transparent background and generous empty gutters. STRICT BACK VIEW toward screen top; NO FACE. Frame subjects are WAIST-UP ONLY, back of head to waist, enlarged upper torso, all moving arms/weapons fit cell. Keep waist anchor fixed across every frame, constant character scale. ROW1 Idle: wide braced shoulders, shield forward on left arm and sword angled ready in right; three clear small breathing/muscle-shift frames in an alert fighting posture, NOT standing at attention. ROW2 Attack: overhead sword cut, strong shoulder twist, forward follow-through; three sequential frames anticipation, strike, follow-through. ROW3 Guard: raise shield fully, head tucked behind shield, brace shoulders; three sequential frames raising defense, braced impact, held defense. These must be genuinely different hand-drawn action poses, not shifted copies or illustration poses. Low-color 1990s dark fantasy pixel art, chunky 64x80 logical pixels per frame, sharp pixels, navy grey ochre moss orange palette. No effects obscuring silhouette, no text, no labels, no cell borders, absolutely transparent gutters. Each entire pose inside its own equal cell with 12% padding, no crossing neighboring cells.
